overview: DMA controller data transfer bina CPU ke; burst vs cycle stealing; CPU time percentage stolen.
coreConcept: DMA memory bus cycles steal karke transfer karta hai; CPU sirf setup aur completion interrupt handle karta hai.
hinglishExplanation: Cycle stealing me ek word transfer karke bus wapas CPU ko. Burst me poora block. Percentage CPU time = (DMA cycles per byte / total cycles) x 100.
formalDefinition: DMA memory bus cycles steal karke transfer karta hai; CPU sirf setup aur completion interrupt handle karta hai.
importantProperties: Burst mode: block transfer, CPU blocked.
Cycle stealing: ek word/cycle, CPU thoda slow.
DMA highest throughput for bulk disk transfers.
Data count register bits = max transfer size.
Number of transfers = data / data count capacity.
